entityDescription:
Trust-IT is a UK SME specialised in research analysis & communication in the field of Information and Communication Technologies (ICT) as well as the development & implementation of innovative web & mobile applications across Europe and globally. In recent years it has turned its expertise into developing tools and services for smaller companies in the areas for cybersecurity and providing free, online tools for making cloud computing easier for novices especially SMEs. Founded in 2002, Trust-IT’s central asset is a highly skilled, dynamic, international team that performs quality ICT market research and result-oriented stakeholder communication and engagement strategies, working closely with SMEs, government and research institutions. Trust-IT is committed to drive forward new ideas, pinpoint market opportunities, create multi-stakeholder partnership and build international networks and communities. It has gained high expertise in the ICT areas, covering both the technological and human interaction aspects and creating innovative business models & exploitation plans.

Trust-IT is a prime mover in bringing global, ICT communities together and has a long-lasting, deep know-how in conducting user experience analyses with stakeholders, as well as contributing to innovation projects and standardisation initiatives. The Company has vast experience in co-ordination of EC-funded CSA initiatives, as well as in roll-out of sustainability activities for organisations involved in innovation efforts, with a focus on market uptake, see for instance the initiative RDA Europe (http://europe.rd-alliance.org/ ) on data-driven innovation, and its effort in development and promotion of Cloud Computing Tools and Services for SMEs (e.g., www.cloudwatchhub.eu ; www.picse.eu; www.sla-ready.eu). With over 15 years of experience in the analysis of complex ICT systems and digital community development, Trust-IT plays a central part in leading the Communication, Community Building & Exploitation activities.

entityDescription:
BCMaterials is an autonomous research center that covers all aspects of research in Functional Materials with advanced Electric, Magnetic and Optical properties; from basic aspects to applications. Special activity is devoted to thin films materials and characterization techniques involving Large International Facilities, like neutron and synchrotron radiation sources.
BCMaterials’ mission – Basque Center for Materials, Applications and Nanostructures – is to develop high-quality interdisciplinary research in functional and active Materials with advanced Mechanical, Thermal, Electric, Magnetic and Optical properties; from basic to applied. Materials in thin film form and characterization techniques involving Large International Facilities, such as neutron and synchrotron radiation sources, will be essential.

In order to achieve the mission outlined above, BCMaterials works towards the following challenges:
•To work in close collaboration with research groups in Materials Science at the University of the Basque Country (UPV/EHU) in Biscay, promoting worldwide their activity in this field.
•To carry out high-level post-graduate training in new materials.
•To promote interdisciplinary collaboration with leading centers as the driving force behind major scientific and technological advances.

Materials in thin film form and characterization techniques involving Large International Facilities, such as neutron and synchrotron radiation sources, will be essential.

In order to achieve the mission outlined above, BCMaterials works towards the following challenges:
•To work in close collaboration with research groups in Materials Science at the University of the Basque Country (UPV/EHU) in Biscay, promoting worldwide their activity in this field.
•To carry out high-level post-graduate training in new materials.
•To promote interdisciplinary collaboration with leading centers as the driving force behind major scientific and technological advances.

entityName: Tallinna Tehnikaulikool - Department of Marine Systems
entityDescription: Department of Marine Systems (MSI) at TalTech employs about 50 persons, among them about 25 with PhD or equivalent degree, and is a leading national research body to study the physical forcing of the Baltic Sea ecosystem. MSI has the expertise in the field of remote sensing method development and environmental big data analytics. Moreover, MSI has a long-term experience in applied studies for developing measures and services for (marine) environment monitoring, forecasting and protection in cooperation with Estonian and European environmental management authorities (CMEMS, HELCOM, EEA, environmental agencies around the Baltic Sea). Also, MSI has developed an expertise in modelling and analyzing atmospheric as well as marine processes (from operational monitoring and forecasting to climate reanalysis and projections). The R&D activities have led to a number of operational monitoring and forecasting services: sea ice charting and flood mapping from Earth Observation data, marine weather monitoring and forecasting, wave forecasting, sea level monitoring etc. MSI is a (i) member of CMEMS consortia (BAL_MFC) providing the marine monitoring and forecasting core service since 2015 and (ii) member of consortia developing the Destination Earth’s on-demand extremes digital twin for ECMWF under the leadership of Meteo-France ( https://stories.ecmwf.int/m-t-o-france-wins-bid-to-develop-destination-earth-s-on-demand-extremes-digital-twin/index.html). Thus, MSI is a leading national body in operational oceanography/meteorology and a member of CMEMS-BALMFC, Destination Earth Extremes_DT, EuroGOOS, BOOS, JERICO, EmodNET and FerryBox consortia. TalTech (Department of Marine Systems) has developed and run operational sea level forecast system since 2006, 3D ocean-ice forecast since 2009 and wave monitoring/forecasts since 2011.

entityDescription:
Founded in February 2015, WaterView is a limited company and a spinoff of the Politecnico di Torino. Its founders developed and patented a novel technology to measure weather variables from images, aiming at collecting and commercialising global weather Big Data. WaterView introduces a pervasive solution for abating the costs and improving the quality of weather mapping. The solution is built around WaterView’s patented technology that uses artificial intelligence and computer vision techniques to transform imaging devices like surveillance IP cameras into “eyes” for seeing, gauging and returning weather measures in real time. By augmenting the potential of non-dedicated, existing hardware, WaterView integrates traditional monitoring networks (which are sparse and expensive) with cheaper, denser and smarter networks of new unconventional sensors, thus disrupting the current panorama of weather sensing.
WaterView offer is currently composed by the first release WeatherCAM service, targeted to the owners of IP cameras networks (municipalities, civil protection agencies, road and traffic managers, etc.) willing to use their cameras not only for surveillance purposes but also as digital weather stations. The service includes the real-time access to dedicated dashboards and APIs to download/access the time series to be included in customers’ workflow. 
A plugin to enable local pre-processing and connect cameras to the computing cloud infrastructure is available for products of the leading manufacturer Axis Communications (recently acquired by Canon). WaterView was awarded as one of the Top 100 Startups (out of 3600 applicants from 90+ countries) at the global Hello Tomorrow Challenge 2015, it resulted among the 10 digital finalists (out of 900+) of the UniCredit StartLab Contest 2015, is among the 10 Italian winners of the Startup European Awards 2017 and one of the 5 Italian scale-up selected by NextEnergy, the open innovation program of Terna Group. In year 2016 WaterView was awarded a SME-Phase 1 grant entitled SmartRAIN: an IoT-based solution for real time rain mapping. WaterView technology and vision has already raised the interest of investors (500k investment in 2016) and early customers.

entityDescription:
Walloon Agricultural Research Centre

CRA-W maintains extensive contacts with farmers, horticulturalists, businesses, universities and research centres in Belgium and abroad. It thus takes part in numerous European, national and regional research projects. The Centre's active presence in development assistance is further proof of its international stature. The CRA-W's work is recognised through the appointment of its researchers to advise national and international organisations, the certifications gained in recent years and the designation of some of its Units as reference laboratories.

 The range of services and analyses provided by the Centre covers all aspects of agriculture.

entityDescription:
O'Sol develops mobile deployable solar generators for temporary or emergency situations. They are based on a deployment technology inspired from satellites which allows a reversible and automatic deployment of a large surface of solar cells. The generators are also equipped with batteries to make them independent from the grid, and can be interconnected to rapidly build a modular electrical network. O'Sol also develops an online platform to monitor the generators remotely.
O'Sol targets mainly humanitarian applications, festivals and communities in remote locations.

entityDescription:
Currently, the unmanned aircraft industry is growing up so fast. There are many open possibilities for developing new applications, especially in the civil sector. The drones (also known as RPAs or UAVs) are already revolutionizing many different sectors as diverse as the agriculture and power industry among many others, being a fundamental tool for digital transformation toward Industry 4.0. 
Globally there are many companies developing the drone technology for civilian use. HEMAV introduces an innovative concept of its own technology integration and development. Alongside many differential capabilities, commitment to high service quality and safety and a good forward thinking for creating value allows HEMAV to be identified as a leader and reference of the whole group of RPAs service operators in Spain.
HEMAV was born the year 2012 in Barcelona, a technological, ambitious and young company which already has two powerhouses (Barcelona and Madrid) and more than eight operational centres in Spain. HEMAV provides industry digital solutions due to its ability for data automatic processing in the cloud and for the use of drone technology with high quality and safety standards.
HEMAV is specialized in smart and automatic data and images processing and pioneer in the aeronautical and operational drone technology development. It all is possible thanks to a highly qualified, motivated and multidisciplinary team of more than 40 people, together with their own innovative technology.
HEMAV is a certified and approved company by AESA (State Aviation Safety Agency) as a UAVs operator. It owns a processing and innovation centre in the ESA (European Space Agency) incubator in Barcelona and full geographical coverage.
From a business perspective, HEMAV is structured into three business lines: precision agriculture, critical infrastructure inspection and geomatics. All these lines generate recurrent sales. The value proposal resides in generating layers of basic, advanced or predictive information of high added value and intelligence.
Based on the "from innovation to solutions" strategy, HEMAV allocates more than 30% of resources in Innovation focused on increased upselling from the existing lines or in open new strategic markets. This strategy is based on Open Innovation and is aimed at technology for acquisition and subsequent digital processing of information. The company has in this area the support and collaboration of key entities such as IBM and Telefonica as well as other companies, research centres and universities.
Due to the global innovation that it has, HEMAV has had from the beginning with a clear vocation to internationalization as you can read through the slogan, Driving the civil drone industry.
